evidence.text: Northwind sells the Orion analytics service to enterprise customers. Orion depends on Contoso for compliance reviews. Northwind plans to expand Orion into the Taiwan market in 2027.
Contoso supplies compliance reviews for Orion. Contoso uses the Helios evidence platform to track audit evidence. A Helios outage delays compliance reviews and can block Orion releases.

Northwind allocates its 2027 engineering budget to Orion reliability and Taiwan expansion. Contoso requires a recovery exercise for Helios before approving Orion expansion. Northwind must coordinate the recovery exercise with Contoso and Fabrikam.
